notes.title: Project Sphinx: Launching now for FREE, with a farewell
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43469766/44f9ab79d459c076c443fc96ead608a5ba4ddf9c.png[/img]

Hey everyone,

Today is an important day for Project Sphinx and all puzzle loving gamers! The long-awaited moment has arrived - Project Sphinx is officially out now on Steam, and it's absolutely free, no costs at all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43469766/f277b9b5231b7ddfaa2eaf4d600b4123276167e0.png[/img]

However, this comes with an important announcement. We regret to inform you that after much consideration, the development of Project Sphinx will come to a close. This was a hard, but a necessary decision that we made after carefully considering all possible options.

[b]BUT! Good news is, we are making what our team managed to create absolutely for free, for you to enjoy.[/b]

While Project Sphinx’s story is not fully completed, we wanted to give you the chance to experience the first several captivating levels filled with mind-bending puzzles before we bid farewell. That means you’ll have free access to a part of the game and while not complete, we’re sure these are going to scratch that platformer puzzle itch and provide a few long hours of entertainment. The difficulties will increase as you progress through the levels and the station’s rooms and corridors, but so do the options and abilities for your character. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43469766/a5caf6fbdfc5f5606ef74bc6b3c92701057bf851.png[/img]

So, are you ready to embark on this bittersweet journey through the space station's corridors? If so, download the game and embrace this final adventure as you put your problem-solving and platform-jumping skills to the ultimate test.

We are immensely grateful to each and every one of you, who supported this development journey. We honestly hope you'll have fun during the moments you spend within the world of Project Sphinx, even in its unfinished state.

If you like the game, please share it with your friends! Also, if you have any thoughts or opinions, be sure to write a review or leave your comments on the forums. We’ll be sure to follow the game’s page after the launch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43469766/56cccc6ac9be385b7e9ae0464d44b691893e496e.png[/img]

Thank you for being a part of this incredible adventure. While Project Sphinx may have a bittersweet ending, we had incredible fun making the game and hopefully, you’ll have fun playing it as well.

If you’d like to stay in touch with all our latest updates and info on all of our future projects, be sure to sign up for our mailing list!!!

[url=http://eepurl.com/h_13bX][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43469766/790a7c68a37215d650354bb18b9b436e516c448e.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Project Sphinx Next Fest Stream #2!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43469766/b33e969f60267a62c42d77277ee7b2744150d49f.png[/img]

Hello, fellow robots!

Steam Next Fest 2023 is in full swing and it’s got a bunch of great games, but none is as mechanically brain-burning as Project Sphinx! If you want to see what the game is all about for yourself, tune in for our second Next Fest livestream, happening Thursday, June 22nd at 5PM!

In Project Sphinx, as a robot armed with the "Portable Arm-mounted Wormhole Slinger" (PAWS), you'll defy gravity, teleport all around a space station and solve mind-bending puzzles! You’ll bounce your way through destroyed halls, shattered stairways, and rooms that seem to have no escape. It's like a cosmic game of puzzle-pinball, but with way cooler technology, so you definitely don’t want to miss out on it!

Be sure to set a reminder and join us when the stream happens on June 22nd, 5PM CET. See you there!

notes.title: Project Sphinx Next Fest Stream #1!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43469766/fd38abc3dbf167436eca5ade44f84fa821af6f36.png[/img]

Greetings, robot friends,

Mark your calendars for Monday, June 19th at 10:00 PM! Join us for an exclusive stream event during the Steam Next Fest to get a glimpse of Project Sphinx - the new first-person puzzle platformer set on an abandoned space station.

In Project Sphinx, you’ll play as a robot equipped with teleportation abilities and navigate destroyed halls and rooms, solve puzzles and overcome various other obstacles. Steam Next Fest provides the perfect platform for Project Sphinx, and we can't wait to showcase its unique blend of puzzle-solving, platforming, and teleportation mechanics during this event. Trust us, you won't want to miss out!

The game will be played by Banzainator - a fantastic professional streamer who kindly agreed to show you all what the game has to offer.

So be sure to tune in to our event on June 19th at 10:00 PM for the livestream!

notes.title: Project Sphinx demo is out! Play it now!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

This is official information from our corporate overlords - Project Sphinx demo is out now. The assignment is to download it and play the game. That's a chance no highly advanced and versatile, top of the line robot would miss - and neither should you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43469766/86a3c3994596d41589d38cc221eee6de534a58ae.png[/img]

Project Sphinx is a platformer puzzle full of fun and challenges. Although the demo is but a taste of what’s to come in the full game, we think it offers more than enough to let you know what the game is all about. You’ll be teleporting and jumping all around the first few levels and we sincerely hope you’ll have lots of fun doing so.

And if you like it - Wishlist the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2230990/Project_Sphinx/
